verdict.rationale: Base44 offers an 'eject' CLI command that downloads frontend code and backend resources into a new standalone project with its own app ID, and supports GitHub sync for code — enabling a real path to leave the platform with your app's code intact. However, the evidence doesn't confirm that user data records themselves (e.g., database tables) are exported to an open, portable format (CSV/JSON) as part of this process, only that code/resources are ejected. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of full data-record export in open formats, and independent/hands-on confirmation that an ejected app is fully functional and data-complete outside Base44.
